title: 第二章 提出假结婚
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈时觐眉头皱得更深了。

她果然就是个为达目的不择手段的坏女人。

“林栀，你当我是傻子吗？”他盯着她，眼底冒着火：“你这女人还真是狡猾。”

沈时觐发火的时候，林栀心里瞬间涌过万千想法。

她在想，如果直接喊人来，怕是即便沈时觐答应娶她，日后也不会给她好果子吃。

硬攻肯定不行。

他这么机智，继续装傻也不行。

像他这种男人，应该会……

喜欢柔弱可怜的女人？

林栀想了想，酝酿一番，眼角瞬间有了泪。

她缓缓抬头看他，泪水顺着脸颊滑落：“我不是故意的，实在是被逼无奈，这才……”

沈时觐冷着脸打断她：“事情都做了，你还在这里装什么。”

林栀见沈时觐厌恶这一套，擦擦眼泪，适时抛出自己的真实想法。

“沈时觐，事情已经出了，我只能嫁给你了。”

“我知道你对我没感情，我也不想勉强你，等你娶我进门后，对外我们是夫妻，对内就各过各的。”

她生怕他理解不了，解释道：“也就是假结婚，两年后我们就离婚。”

两年时间，足够她借着沈时觐在这里站稳脚跟了。

假结婚？沈时觐面色一凛。

婚姻不是儿戏，结了婚就要过一辈子的，他怎么可能答应她假结婚，她把他当成什么人了？

他打量着她，眼神暗了暗。

他想不通这个年纪不大的小丫头，怎么会把结婚离婚这件事看得这么淡。

转念又想，爬床这种事她都做得出来，就又觉得没什么稀奇了。

“这事不着急，你慢慢考虑。”

林栀知道沈时觐需要时间消化这件事，更知道他是个负责的人，早晚跑不掉。

她扶着墙动作迟缓地朝炕边走，临下炕前还不忘把被子往旁边扯了扯。

等到露出下面的褥子，她才拖着快要散架的身子离开了。

不经意间，沈时觐瞧见了褥子上的那抹殷红。

他望着林栀远去的背影，陷入了沉思。

天大亮后，沈时觐到了堂屋。

八仙桌上，林家夫妻林大国和陈琴坐在南面，林柔规规矩矩地坐在东面，林栀姿态随性地坐在西边。

他跟他们打过招呼后，林家夫妻就热情地招呼他坐到林柔旁边。

眼眸半敛，他坐在了就近的位置。

Page (1/3)

Shen Shijin's frown deepened.

She is indeed a bad woman who will do whatever it takes to achieve her goals.

"Lin Zhi, do you think I'm a fool?" He stared at her, his eyes burning: "You are such a cunning woman."

When Shen Shijin got angry, Lin Zhi's heart suddenly surged with thousands of thoughts.

She was thinking that if she called someone directly, she was afraid that even if Shen Shijin agreed to marry her, he would not give her good results in the future.

A hard attack will definitely not work.

He's so smart, he can't continue to act stupid.

A man like him should be able to...

Do you like weak and pitiful women?

Lin Zhi thought about it for a while, and suddenly there were tears in the corners of her eyes.

She slowly raised her head to look at him, tears sliding down her cheeks: "I didn't mean it, I was really forced to do nothing, so..."

Shen Shijin interrupted her with a cold face: "Everything has been done, why are you still pretending here?"

Seeing that Shen Shijin was disgusted with this, Lin Zhi wiped his tears and expressed his true thoughts at the right time.

"Shen Shijin, the matter has come out, I can only marry you."

"I know you have no feelings for me, and I don't want to force you. After you marry me, we will be husband and wife externally, but we will live our own lives internally."

She was afraid that he wouldn't understand, so she explained: "It's a fake marriage, and we will divorce in two years."

Two years were enough for her to gain a foothold here through Shen Shijin.

Fake marriage?Shen Shijin's face turned serious.

Marriage is not a child's play. Once you get married, you will live it for a lifetime. How could he agree to her fake marriage? Who does she think he is?

He looked at her, his eyes darkening.

He couldn't understand how this young girl could take the matter of marriage and divorce so lightly.

Then I thought about it again, she could do such a thing as climbing on the bed, so I thought it was nothing strange.

"There's no need to rush this, just think about it slowly."

Lin Zhi knew that Shen Shijin needed time to digest this matter, and he also knew that he was a responsible person and would not be able to run away sooner or later.

She held on to the wall and walked slowly towards the kang, not forgetting to pull the quilt aside before getting off the kang.

When the mattress underneath was exposed, she dragged her body that was about to fall apart and left.

Inadvertently, Shen Shijin saw the bright red color on the mattress.

He looked at Lin Zhi's retreating back and fell into deep thought.

After dawn, Shen Shi went to the main room.

On the Eight Immortals table, the Lin family couple Lin Daguo and Chen Qin sat on the south side, Lin Rou sat on the east side in a formal manner, and Lin Zhi sat on the west side with a casual attitude.

After he greeted them, the Lin family warmly invited him to sit next to Lin Rou.

With his eyes half closed, he sat in the nearest seat.
